summary: Execute planner task T-140 by adding provider-neutral stable/dynamic prompt planning and host-observed runtime telemetry without making cache controls authoritative.

candidates.rationale: Add a single bounded context-runtime layer for stable-prefix planning, cache hints, telemetry validation, and cold/warm comparison using the existing benchmark metric schema.
Integrate the new context-runtime protocol into workspace entrypoints, CLI discovery, context docs, verification scope, and tests.

applied_changes.description: Added deterministic prompt block ordering/fingerprints with no cache padding and telemetry records that preserve unavailable host metrics as null rather than invented values.
Integrated context-runtime protocol/policy/tool into ICM discovery and full-regression classification.
